question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8\},$ and the set $S=\{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8\}$ has $|S|=9$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{9}, & x=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $5$ items $(3,4,5,6,7)$ that satisfy $2<X\le 7.$ Therefore,

$$
P(2<X\le 7)=5\cdot \frac{1}{9}=\frac{5}{9}.
$$
